lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: So, what's with the M's on their heads?

lines.speaker: Supreme Kai
lines.text: That is the mark of the Majin.

lines.speaker: Supreme Kai
lines.text: If Babidi finds any evil in your heart, he can use it to control you, turning you into his puppet.

lines.speaker: Supreme Kai
lines.text: Yes, any evil. Even using your phone during a movie, or leaving your shopping cart in a parking space.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: The cart return is, like, right there.

lines.speaker: Babidi
lines.text: Hello, can I speak with a Vegeta?

lines.speaker: Babidi
lines.text: Well, I'm here to make you a... proposition.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Hold on, what about tipping? Because some places actually pay their employees, but others don't.

lines.speaker: Supreme Kai
lines.text: I mean, obviously then you tip at the places that don't.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: This is why I hunt my own food.
